title: Meta Announces Launch of Offering of Depositary Shares Representing Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock and Offering of Class A Common Stock in Connection with Forward Sale Agreements

Meta expects to grant the underwriters of the Common Stock Offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $3.375 billion of shares of the Class A Common Stock.

sentences:
Supports Meta's continued investment in AI infrastructure and personal superintelligence
MENLO PARK, Calif. , Oct.
Meta expects to grant to the underwriters of the Depositary Shares Offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 37,500,000 Depositary Shares, solely to cover over-allotments, if any.
Meta intends to use the net proceeds from the Depositary Shares Offering for general corporate purposes.
Meta expects to grant the underwriters of the Common Stock Offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $3.375 billion of shares of the Class A Common Stock.

If such option is exercised, Meta expects to enter into additional forward sale agreements with each of the forward purchasers (as described below) in respect of the number of shares of the Class A Common Stock that is subject to the exercise of such option.
Meta does not expect to initially receive any proceeds from the sale of shares of Class A Common Stock by the forward purchasers (or their affiliates) in the Common Stock Offering.
Meta intends to use the net proceeds it receives upon future settlement of the forward sale agreements and any additional forward sale agreements for general corporate purposes.
The Preferred Stock is expected to have a liquidation preference of $1,000 per share.
The dividend rate, conversion terms and other terms of the Preferred Stock will be determined at the time of pricing of the Depositary Shares Offering.
Currently, there is no public market for the Depositary Shares or the Preferred Stock.

Meta intends to apply to list the Depositary Shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "METAM."
Concurrently with the Depositary Shares Offering, Meta expects to enter into forward sale agreements with Morgan Stanley Capital Services LLC and Goldman Sachs & Co.
LLC (the "forward purchasers") initially with respect to an aggregate of $22.5 billion of shares of the Class A Common Stock.

Upon the issuance of the Class C Common Stock and satisfaction of certain other conditions, these forward sale agreements will reference both the Class A Common Stock and the Class C Common Stock and, in certain circumstances, Meta will have the ability to settle all of the forward sale agreements through the delivery of only shares of Class C Common Stock.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, upon the issuance of the Class C Common Stock and satisfaction of certain other conditions, these forward sale agreements will reference both the Class A Common Stock and the Class C Common Stock and, in certain circumstances, Meta will have the ability to settle all of the forward sale agreements through the delivery of only shares of Class C Common Stock.

The completion of the Depositary Shares Offering is not conditioned upon completion of the Common Stock Offering, and the completion of the Common Stock Offering is not conditioned upon completion of the Depositary Shares Offering.

In addition to these underwritten offerings, Meta intends to enter into an equity distribution agreement in connection with a newly established ATM program, pursuant to which Meta may sell, from time to time through or to a manager, Class C Common Stock, up to a maximum aggregate offering amount of $60 billion.
Such program is not expected to commence until the first quarter of 2027 following the commencement of trading of the Company's previously announced Class C Common Stock.
Sales under the ATM program are not conditioned upon the underwritten offerings.
LLC are acting as lead joint bookrunning managers for the Offerings.
The Company has filed a registration statement (including a prospectus) with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") for the Company and the Offerings to which this communication relates.

Before you invest, you should read the prospectus in that registration statement and other documents the Company has filed with the SEC for more complete information about the Company and these Offerings.
You may get these documents for free by visiting EDGAR on the SEC website at www.sec.gov .
Alternatively, the Company, any underwriter or any dealer participating in the Offerings will arrange to send you the prospectus if you request it by contacting Morgan Stanley & Co.
LLC, Attention: Prospectus Department, 180 Varick Street, 2nd Floor, New York, NY 10014, by email at [email protected] ; or Goldman Sachs & Co.
LLC, Attention: Prospectus Department, 200 West Street, New York, NY 10282, by telephone at 1-866-471-2526 or by email at [email protected] .

This release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy these securities, nor does it constitute an offer, solicitation or sale of these securities, in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale is unlawful.

NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., and Broadcom Inc. (collectively, the "Cornerstone Investors") have, severally and not jointly, indicated an interest in purchasing up to an aggregate of $5.0 billion of shares of Class A Common Stock offered in the Common Stock Offering at the same price and on the same terms and conditions as the other purchasers in the Common Stock Offering.

Because these indications of interest are not binding agreements or commitments to purchase, any of the Cornerstone Investors may determine to purchase more, fewer, or no shares of Class A Common Stock in the Common Stock Offering, or the underwriters may determine to sell more, fewer, or no shares of Class A Common Stock to any of the Cornerstone Investors.

The underwriters will receive the same underwriting discount on any shares of Class A Common Stock purchased by the Cornerstone Investors as they will from the other shares of Class A Common Stock sold to the public in the Common Stock Offering.
